subject.title: [Bug]: Windows gateway listens but local health/status time out after Telegram polling stall (v2026.5.20)

question: Should repeated unrecoverable Telegram/channel stalls escalate from in-process channel restart to supervisor-level Gateway restart, and should that be default or opt-in?
rationale: The reported failure may require killing the whole Gateway process to recover, but that changes active-turn, session, and operator expectations and the targeted live repro did not yet reproduce the long-term poison on current tooling.

options.title: Require Live Proof First
options.body: Keep current recovery policy until an affected-host current-main repro proves the process-level stall and identifies whether Telegram, session, or Gateway ownership is responsible.

options.title: Default Supervisor Escalation
options.body: After exhausted channel restart attempts, exit non-zero under the existing supervisor and accept the active-turn interruption risk with focused tests and docs.

options.title: Opt-In Watchdog
options.body: Add an explicit operator-controlled watchdog or doctor-recommended recovery path for unreachable-but-listening Gateway hosts without changing default restart semantics.

recommendation.title: Require Live Proof First
recommendation.body: Keep current recovery policy until an affected-host current-main repro proves the process-level stall and identifies whether Telegram, session, or Gateway ownership is responsible.

likelyOwner.reason: joshavant already ran the targeted live repro attempt on this issue and has recent history on the Telegram polling watchdog path.
